P1.F2.H1 is a test-only addition and does not establish a tier on its own. observations.behavior: Replaces the value for the key '401 Client Error' in the returned dictionary from None to a user-facing message, while retaining the key.
observations.code_quote: "401 Client Error": "Your Reddit Ads connection is no longer valid. Reconnect your Reddit account in the source settings, then re-enable the sync.",
observations.posthog_connection: This change updates the error handling for Reddit Ads ingestion. When the Reddit API returns a 401, the warehouse ingestion pipeline will no longer stop silently; it will return a message instructing the user to reconnect their account, rather than failing with no explanation.
